description:

**[AI-Driven Network Operations with Cisco Catalyst Center](https://www.netcomlearning.com/webinar/AI-driven-network-operations-with-cisco-catalyst-center?advid=1196&utm_source=meetup&utm_medium=event&utm_campaign=cisco_fy26_q2&utm_content=webinars)**

name: The Autonomous Threat: AWS Security When AI Pulls the Trigger
description:
# [The Autonomous Threat: AWS Security When AI Pulls the Trigger](https://www.netcomlearning.com/webinar/the-autonomous-threat-aws-security-when-ai-pulls-the-trigger?advid=1196&utm_source=meetup&utm_medium=event&utm_campaign=aws_fy26_q3&utm_content=organic_listing&utm_term=sp)

Join this exclusive AWS-focused masterclass to explore the emerging security challenges of autonomous and agentic AI systems, and learn how organizations can secure AI-driven decision-making, automate threat response safely, and maintain control when AI acts at machine speed on AWS.

**Date:** July 22, 2026
**Time:** 12 PM – 2 PM EDT
**[Click here to Register for the session!](https://www.netcomlearning.com/webinar/the-autonomous-threat-aws-security-when-ai-pulls-the-trigger?advid=1196&utm_source=meetup&utm_medium=event&utm_campaign=aws_fy26_q3&utm_content=organic_listing&utm_term=sp)**

This masterclass provides practical insights into securing autonomous AI systems using AWS services, governance frameworks, and security best practices. Learn how to build resilient architectures that enable innovation without sacrificing visibility, control, or compliance.

**NOTE:** *ALL REGISTRATIONS WILL BE PROVIDED WITH FREE EXCLUSIVE RESOURCES*

### What You Will Learn:

• Understanding the security risks introduced by autonomous and Agentic AI systems
• How AI-driven workflows can impact cloud security, governance, and compliance
• Securing AI agents, automated decision engines, and orchestration frameworks on AWS
• Implementing guardrails, monitoring, and human oversight for autonomous AI actions
• Identity, access management, and least-privilege strategies for AI-powered environments
• Best practices for building secure, scalable, and trustworthy AI architectures on AWS
